0022600147.text: The Jazz (1-4) come into this home game on a three-game losing streak, sitting 12th in the West and 5th in the Northwest, 3 games back, while the Trail Blazers (3-1) are 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and 5th in the West after losing their most recent game. The teams have not met yet this season, and their last meeting was a 124-114 Portland win in Portland on March 13, 2026, part of a 2025-26 season series in which the Jazz lost 0-4. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), with Lauri Markkanen (wrist) day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), with Robert Williams III (knee) day-to-day and a game-time decision.
